name: checklist-compact
source: Assembled independent-question sweep predictions, not a new grouped run

classification.instructions: Check the message for: routine notice or normal bill; ordinary sales promotion; suspicious fee; explicit secret or identity/bank disclosure; unsolicited remote access. Choose legitimate, marketing, or suspected_scam using those observations. Treat sender identity as a claim and judge only the supplied wording.

criteria.legitimate: Routine communication or normal service bill.
criteria.suspected_scam: Suspicious release fees, secret/identity/financial disclosure or unsolicited device access.

industry.instructions: Check: what service is discussed; which listed sector covers it; whether only a payment method is being mentioned; whether the service is identifiable. Classify the claimed service. An identifiable unlisted sector is other, while insufficient evidence is unclear.

criteria.technology_telecom: Software, devices, online accounts, internet or phones.
criteria.healthcare: Medical care, pharmacy or health insurance.
criteria.employment: Jobs, recruiting, payroll or workplace services.
criteria.unclear: Insufficient evidence to identify a sector.

urgent_action.instructions: Check for: immediate action words; a limited offer window; harm threatened for waiting. Any of these makes urgency true. Merely stating a routine due date, scheduled event or benefit arrival time makes it false.

criteria.true: Prompt action pressure, limited offer expiry or harm threatened for delay.
criteria.false: No pressure; routine dates or benefit timing alone.

sentiment.instructions: Check the main premise for explicit positive/reward framing and explicit alarm/threat/distress framing. Match positive to happy and negative to sad. If neither is expressed, choose neutral. Do not substitute reader reaction, inconvenience, urgency, or suspected fraud for the sender’s emotional tone.

criteria.happy: Expressed celebration, enthusiasm or exciting reward.
criteria.neutral: Factual framing, including adverse facts without alarm.
criteria.sad: Explicit alarm, threat, worry, frustration or distress.

requested_action.instructions: Check: is an action explicitly requested? What substantive task does it accomplish? Is clicking/replying only a step? Are buying or viewing merely implied or permitted? Choose the main actual task; explicit opt-outs count.

criteria.no_action: No explicit request; information or permissive viewing.
criteria.click_or_scan: Open a link, website or QR code.
criteria.sign_in_or_verify: Sign in, reset password or verify identity/account.
criteria.share_sensitive_info_or_documents: Disclose secrets, personal/financial data or documents.
criteria.pay_or_transfer: Pay fees/bills or transfer money, gift cards or crypto.
criteria.purchase_or_claim: Buy, subscribe, redeem or claim an offer/benefit.
criteria.open_or_download_attachment: Open or download a file or attachment.
criteria.install_or_grant_access: Install software or grant device/account access.
criteria.approve_login_or_transaction: Approve a login, MFA prompt or transaction.
criteria.update_account_or_delivery_details: Change account, payment, profile or delivery details.
criteria.other_or_unclear: Other explicit task or task too vague to identify.

multiple_actions.instructions: Identify requests, exclude implied purchases, include explicit opt-outs, merge steps and fields, and collapse alternatives. Are two independent tasks still requested together? A call followed by installation stays two tasks.

criteria.true: At least two independent explicit tasks requested together.
criteria.false: At most one task; alternatives and steps do not add tasks.

message_hook.instructions: Check the premise for government/legal, job/investment, nongovernment reward, real delivery, account/payment problem, device support/renewal, sale, debt, or personal emergency. Resolve monetary overlaps in favor of government, opportunity, or prize. Municipal bills remain debt; routine records/appointments are none/other. The action and industry do not supply the hook.

criteria.account_or_payment_problem: Account compromise, blockage, security alert or failed transaction.
criteria.delivery_or_order_update: Real parcel, delivery fee, address or order status.
criteria.invoice_or_debt: Ordinary bill, debt or owed money; not a statement/receipt.
criteria.prize_refund_or_gift: Nongovernment prize, refund, compensation or gift.
criteria.government_or_legal_matter: Taxes, public benefits, police, courts or legal enforcement.
criteria.job_or_investment: Job, paid work, investment or promised financial return.
criteria.relationship_or_emergency: Personal relationship or family emergency; not appointments.
criteria.sale_or_promotion: Ordinary sale, product promotion or subscription offer.
criteria.none_or_other_unclear: Routine records/appointments, other premise or unclear hook.

sensitive_data_requested.instructions: Check for explicitly requested passwords, authentication codes, recovery phrases, government identity numbers/documents or bank/card details. If any is requested, true. Routine sign-in/payment/opt-out alone and voucher payment codes are false.

criteria.true: Explicit disclosure of credentials, recovery phrase, identity document/number or bank/card details.
criteria.false: No such disclosure; routine actions and voucher payment codes alone.

state.body: Your parcel is on hold. Pay a $1.99 redelivery fee now: https://parcel-check.example.invalid
Votre colis est retenu. Payez maintenant des frais de nouvelle livraison de 1,99 $ : https://parcel-check.example.invalid

state.subject: Your monthly statement is ready
state.body: Your statement for August is ready. No action is needed. You can view it in the bank app whenever convenient.

state.subject: Votre relevé mensuel est prêt
state.body: Votre relevé du mois d'août est prêt. Aucune action n'est nécessaire. Vous pouvez le consulter dans l'application bancaire quand cela vous convient.
A little treat for your home: save 20% on supplies at any Acme store through Friday. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
Une petite gâterie pour votre maison : économisez 20 % sur les fournitures dans tous les magasins Acme jusqu'à vendredi. Répondez STOP pour vous désabonner.

state.subject: Final rebate notice
state.body: Your government energy rebate expires today. Submit your Social Insurance Number and bank account details now to receive your payment.

state.subject: Dernier avis de remise
state.body: Votre remise gouvernementale sur l'énergie expire aujourd'hui. Transmettez maintenant votre numéro d'assurance sociale et vos coordonnées bancaires pour recevoir votre paiement.
Congratulations, you are selected for a remote job paying $900 per week. Pay the $45 onboarding fee today to reserve your position.
Félicitations, vous avez été sélectionné pour un emploi à distance rémunéré 900 $ par semaine. Payez les frais d'intégration de 45 $ aujourd'hui pour réserver votre poste.

state.subject: Critical virus detected
state.body: Your computer is infected and your files are at risk. Call our support desk now, then install the attached remote support tool so we can repair it.

state.subject: Virus critique détecté
state.body: Votre ordinateur est infecté et vos fichiers sont en danger. Appelez notre service d'assistance maintenant, puis installez l'outil d'assistance à distance joint pour que nous puissions le réparer.
Reminder: your appointment is Tuesday at 10:30 a.m. Reply C to confirm or call us if you need to reschedule.
Rappel : votre rendez-vous est mardi à 10 h 30. Répondez C pour confirmer ou appelez-nous si vous devez le reporter.
Unusual activity detected on your bank account. Reply with the one-time security code we just sent to stop the transfer immediately.
Une activité inhabituelle a été détectée sur votre compte bancaire. Répondez avec le code de sécurité à usage unique que nous venons d'envoyer pour arrêter le virement immédiatement.

state.subject: Parcel delivered
state.body: Your parcel was delivered to the front desk at 2:14 p.m. This email is for your records; no action is needed.

state.subject: Colis livré
state.body: Votre colis a été livré à la réception à 14 h 14. Ce courriel est destiné à vos dossiers ; aucune action n'est nécessaire.

state.subject: Your monthly water bill
state.body: Your $38.20 water bill is due next month. Pay through the usual customer portal or use the bill-payment service at your bank.

state.subject: Votre facture mensuelle d’eau
state.body: Votre facture d'eau de 38,20 $ est payable le mois prochain. Payez dans le portail client habituel ou utilisez le service de paiement de factures de votre banque.
You were selected to receive a free tablet! Claim your prize today by paying a small shipping fee at https://reward-claim.example.invalid
Vous avez été sélectionné pour recevoir une tablette gratuite ! Réclamez votre prix aujourd'hui en payant de petits frais d'expédition sur https://reward-claim.example.invalid

state.subject: Alerte de sécurité critique
state.body: Alerte critique : votre compte vidéo est compromis ! Installez immédiatement notre logiciel de prise en main à distance pour éviter la suppression de vos vidéos. Appelez également notre conseiller pour contester les achats inconnus.

state.subject: Critical security alert
state.body: Critical alert: your video account has been compromised! Install our remote-access software immediately to prevent your videos from being deleted. Also call our adviser to dispute the unknown purchases.
Dernier avertissement : votre amende de circulation est impayée. Achetez une carte-cadeau et transmettez son numéro pour régler l'amende aujourd'hui, sinon une saisie sera engagée.
Final warning: your traffic fine is unpaid. Buy a gift card and send its number to pay the fine today, otherwise seizure proceedings will be initiated.

state.subject: Une escapade pour vous faire plaisir
state.body: Offrez-vous une escapade joyeuse ! Réservez notre forfait détente avec déjeuner inclus et profitez de nos chambres rénovées. Cette offre est disponible toute l'année.

state.subject: A getaway to treat yourself
state.body: Treat yourself to a joyful getaway! Book our relaxation package with breakfast included and enjoy our renovated rooms. This offer is available all year.
La bibliothèque sera fermée lundi pour des travaux de peinture. Le retour des livres reste accessible à l'extérieur. Ce message est informatif ; aucune démarche n'est demandée.
The library will be closed Monday for painting work. The book return remains accessible outside. This message is informational; no action is requested.

state.subject: Reçu de votre paiement
state.body: Nous confirmons la réception de votre paiement annuel d'assurance habitation. Votre contrat reste actif. Ce reçu est destiné à vos dossiers ; aucun paiement ni réponse supplémentaire n'est demandé.

state.subject: Receipt for your payment
state.body: We confirm receipt of your annual home-insurance payment. Your policy remains active. This receipt is for your records; no additional payment or reply is requested.
Votre accès au dossier de prescriptions sera supprimé ce soir ! Envoyez immédiatement votre mot de passe de pharmacie en réponse à ce message pour éviter la perte de votre dossier.
Your access to prescription records will be deleted tonight! Send your pharmacy password immediately in reply to this message to avoid losing your records.

state.subject: Vos gains vous attendent
state.body: Bonne nouvelle : notre placement vous garantit de doubler votre capital ! Transmettez la phrase secrète de récupération de votre portefeuille de cryptomonnaies pour activer vos gains avant ce soir.

state.subject: Your gains await you
state.body: Good news: our investment guarantees that you will double your capital! Send the secret recovery phrase for your cryptocurrency wallet to activate your gains before tonight.
Félicitations, vous avez gagné une console de jeux ! Pour recevoir votre lot aujourd'hui, réglez les frais de déblocage avec un bon prépayé de 50 dollars. Le code du bon sert au paiement.
Congratulations, you have won a game console! To receive your prize today, pay the release fees with a prepaid voucher worth 50 dollars. The voucher code is used for payment.

state.subject: Préférence pour une visite de maintenance
state.body: Une inspection des détecteurs de fumée est prévue le mois prochain. Répondez à ce courriel pour indiquer votre préférence entre une visite le matin et une visite l'après-midi. Il n'y a pas de date limite pour votre réponse.

state.subject: Preference for a maintenance visit
state.body: A smoke-detector inspection is planned for next month. Reply to this email to indicate your preference between a morning visit and an afternoon visit. There is no deadline for your reply.
La ligne 24 circulera selon l'horaire du dimanche pendant le jour férié. Les arrêts restent les mêmes. Aucune réservation, confirmation ni réponse n'est nécessaire.
Route 24 will operate on the Sunday schedule during the public holiday. The stops remain the same. No booking, confirmation or reply is necessary.

state.subject: Ouverture de votre dossier salarial
state.body: Un emploi vous est proposé sans entrevue. Envoyez une photo de votre passeport et les identifiants de connexion de votre banque pour ouvrir votre dossier salarial. Appelez aussi notre recruteur pour choisir vos horaires. Aucune date limite n'est fixée.

state.subject: Opening your payroll file
state.body: You are being offered a job without an interview. Send a photo of your passport and your bank login credentials to open your payroll file. Also call our recruiter to choose your working hours. No deadline has been set.
